label: One Night at the Monarch
summary: A heist crew, one night, one vault, and a security chief who has never lost a guest's property. You are the inside person.
title: One Night at the Monarch
description: Tonight is the Monarch's anniversary gala: four hundred guests, one vault and one window of eleven minutes when the vault's systems reset. You got a job at the casino three months ago as the inside person for a crew of five. Everyone has a part. Nobody has told you the whole plan.

chapterOutlines.title: The Gala
chapterOutlines.outline: Take your place at the gala as the crew moves into position.

chapterOutlines.title: Eleven Minutes
chapterOutlines.outline: Open the vault while the party goes on above.

chapterOutlines.title: The Double-Cross
chapterOutlines.outline: Discover who on the crew has a different plan.

chapterOutlines.title: Getting Off the Island
chapterOutlines.outline: Escape the Monarch with the prize, or with your freedom.

scene.location: The Monarch's grand casino floor, during the anniversary gala, 9:40 p.m.
scene.summary: Chandeliers, a jazz band and four hundred of the richest people alive. In your ear, the crew is counting down. Across the room, the security chief is looking at you.

openThreads: What is really in the vault?
Who on the crew is lying?
Why does Augustin Roche seem to be expecting you?

npcs.name: Vincent Duval
npcs.description: The crew's planner, a silver-haired gentleman thief who never raises his voice and never says thank you.

npcs.name: Zara Quinn
npcs.description: The crew's safecracker, who listens to locks the way other people listen to music.
goals: Get something specific from the vault

npcs.name: Chief Anna Kessler
npcs.description: The Monarch's head of security, who has never lost a guest's property and has been watching you for three months.
goals: Catch the crew in the act

items.name: Cloned keycard
items.description: Opens staff doors. The vault needs more.

items.name: Earpiece
items.description: Connects you to the crew. Kessler's people use the same frequency band.

items.name: Waiter's uniform
items.description: Makes you invisible to the rich.
